sloka: सा विमुक्ता ततो रम्भा भ्रष्टमाल्यविभूषणा ।गजेन्द्राक्रीडमथिता नदीवाकुलतां गता ।। ७.२६.४३ ॥
transliteration: sā vimuktā tato rambhā bhraṣṭamālyavibhūṣaṇā ।gajendrākrīḍamathitā nadīvākulatāṁ gatā ।। 7.26.43 ॥

translations.english: Rambha, thus released, with her garlands and ornaments fallen, became agitated like a river churned by the sport of a lordly elephant.
